description: Project module for styio-spio package management, registry, resolver, toolchain, process, and control-plane code.
technology_stack: C++ package manager, resolver, registry, toolchain, and process code built with CMake and CTest
Python registry, control-plane, docs, hygiene, and interop gates
JSON, TOML, and lockfile contract artifacts
TypeScript and web fixture surfaces present in the repository
internal_components: SpioManifest, SpioResolve, and SpioPlan manifest/resolver/compile-plan graph
SpioRegistryClient and spio_registry_v2 registry materialization and trust layer
SpioToolchain and SpioTool managed compiler/toolchain state
SpioCore Process and SpioCloud control-plane integration
Native, interop, unit, docs, and delivery gate suites
Registry v2 publish, verify, keygen, promote, and control-plane helper scripts
dependency_manifests: pyproject.toml or TOML support files where present
security_boundaries: Authentication and authorization implementation may be public when it is standard registry or control-plane protocol behavior.
Privacy and PII payloads must not be committed in registry fixtures, examples, reports, or logs.
Password storage is not a production styio-spio responsibility; any password fixture must be fake test data.
Secret, token, key, and credential material must stay private even when key-generation helper code is public.
Production private material, signing keys, registry role keys, and generated key bundles are offline or not committed to GitHub.
Permission matrix and route authorization behavior for registry and control-plane routes must be covered by regression tests.
Deployment security config must document TLS, CORS, CSRF, cookie, debug exposure, and local-only control-plane boundaries where applicable.
SBOM, CVE, and dependency vulnerability scan evidence is required before release or external deployment gates pass.
DAST black-box penetration security regression must cover deployed registry and control-plane HTTP surfaces before public deployment.
Runtime secret manager or KMS key rotation owns production signing keys, hosted tokens, and registry credentials.
Rate limit, anti replay nonce, and idempotency boundaries must be documented for registry publish and control-plane routes.
Log redaction and audit log rules must prevent request tokens, key paths, and credentials from being written to logs.
SSRF egress allowlist and URL allowlist boundaries must cover registry downloads, mirror reads, and outbound control-plane requests.
Command execution must use subprocess allowlists and reject shell injection surfaces for toolchain, compiler, and helper invocations.

resource_classes.description: Owns manifest parsing, dependency graph resolution, lockfile generation, compile-plan selection, and graph serialization.
resource_classes.copying_policy: Resolved graphs and package lists must avoid repeated deep copies in hot command paths; projections should use references, stable ids, or compact payloads.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: Resolver state is command-scoped unless explicitly documented; shared caches require bounded locks and invalidation policy.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Missing manifests, packages, roots, targets, and lock entries must have explicit failure states.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Temporary graph artifacts and lockfile writes must be atomic or have documented recovery behavior.

state_machine.source: Native C++ result types, resolver contracts, lockfile tests, compile-plan tests, and interop gates.

transitions.on: invalid manifest or dependency is rejected
cycle, ambiguity, or source error is detected

required_tests: spio_native_tests for manifest, resolver, lock, and build plan changes
interop compile-plan gate for contract boundary changes
negative tests for malformed manifests and ambiguous roots

resource_classes.description: Owns registry v2 metadata validation, trust roots, artifact download, archive validation, extraction, and materialized package state.
resource_classes.copying_policy: Registry metadata and artifacts must have role-specific size limits before being copied or decoded.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: Registry cache writes must be isolated by target path and avoid shared mutable trust state.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Missing roots, signatures, timestamps, snapshots, manifests, and artifacts must be explicit trust failures.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Downloads and extraction directories must be cleaned on validation failure, timeout, cancellation, and partial extraction.

state_machine.source: Native and Python registry contracts, signed metadata schemas, registry v2 interop gates, and security tests.

transitions.on: metadata or artifact is read within bounds
hash, signature, threshold, and expiry policy pass
trust or size policy rejects input

invalid_operations: trusting registry-provided roots without pin policy
materializing archive entries outside the checkout root

required_tests: registry v2 unit tests for metadata and path validation
interop gates for registry v2 read, publish, and control-plane behavior
malicious archive and trust-chain negative tests for extraction/trust changes

resource_classes.description: Owns managed compiler install, use, pin, status, project state files, and toolchain payload serialization.
resource_classes.copying_policy: Toolchain state payloads must not duplicate large source trees or leak host paths into stable machine contracts.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: State-file updates must be command-scoped and safe under repeated commands; broader concurrency requires locking policy.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Absent state files, missing compilers, invalid pins, and unsupported modes must have explicit status states.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Failed installs and pin updates must leave a recoverable project state and no ambiguous active compiler.

state_machine.source: Toolchain state structs, CLI machine payloads, native tests, and project graph contracts.

transitions.on: state path or compiler is found
state file or compiler is invalid

invalid_operations: reporting success for invalid state files
leaking private source paths in public status

required_tests: native toolchain state, install, pin, and status tests
CLI JSON payload regression for changed machine fields
project graph contract test when toolchain payload changes

resource_classes.description: Owns subprocess execution, timeout behavior, stdout/stderr limits, cloud request payloads, and local control-plane server resources.
resource_classes.copying_policy: Process output and request bodies must be bounded before buffering.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: Long-running subprocesses and servers must have timeout, cancellation, and cleanup behavior.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Missing programs, failed exits, signals, timeouts, and malformed requests must be structured result states.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Process groups, temporary files, sockets, and request resources must be released on exit, timeout, and failure.

state_machine.source: ProcessResult, ProcessRequest, control-plane contracts, interop gates, and timeout tests.

transitions.on: handles and temp resources are released
process group and buffers are released

invalid_operations: running without timeout for network or compiler calls
returning HTTP success for validation failure

required_tests: native process timeout and truncation tests
control-plane contract tests for status, auth, and error status
slow endpoint or failed process regression for changed callers
